axis: +X runs from the New Palace and Court of Honour toward the Old Palace and separate cathedral. The main western square lies on the negative-Z side.
limitations: The palace perimeter and four open spaces come from PMTiles. The west portal, roof heights, turret profiles and interior passage slope are reconstructed from exterior photographs and standard viewer terrain.

The modeled passage links the plaza and Court of Honour as a visualization. Architectural detail, court planting and masonry decoration are approximate. Rooms and below-ground routes are outside the model.
